title: Andre: Name Meaning, Origin & Personality
summary: Andre is a timeless and globally cherished boy's name with deep European roots. It offers a wonderful balance of classic strength and modern charm.
origin: The name Andre has rich historical roots stretching back to ancient Greece, deriving from the personal name Andreas and the root word aner, meaning man or warrior. It entered various European languages through Latin and the spread of early traditions. Today, Andre enjoys enduring popularity across diverse cultures and continents, serving as a staple in Western naming traditions while retaining a fresh, contemporary appeal for modern parents seeking a strong, traditional name.
personality: In popular naming culture, Andre is often associated with individuals who possess natural leadership qualities, quiet confidence, and a adventurous spirit. People with this name are frequently viewed as dependable, creative, and remarkably steadfast in the face of challenges. This moniker suggests a person who is both thoughtful and action-oriented, balancing a strong sense of personal integrity with a warm, approachable demeanor that naturally draws others toward them.
popularity: Andre is a universally recognized name that maintains steady popularity across many parts of the world. It is particularly well-liked in English-speaking nations, France, Scandinavia, and Brazil. Rather than following fleeting trends, the name enjoys a reliable, classic presence, making it a favorite for families seeking a traditional yet effortlessly cosmopolitan choice for their newborn.

faq.q: Is Andre pronounced differently around the world?
faq.ans: Yes, depending on the region and language, it can be pronounced with the emphasis on either the first or second syllable, or with a soft ending vowel. However, all variations share the same warm and strong phonetic appeal.

faq.q: Does Andre have a feminine equivalent?
faq.ans: Yes, popular feminine forms of the name include Andrea and Andriana. These names share the same distinguished historical roots.

faq.q: Is Andre considered a traditional name?
faq.ans: It is a deeply traditional name with centuries of history in European and global naming customs. Despite its age, it consistently feels modern and fresh.

faq.q: What middle names pair well with Andre?
faq.ans: One-syllable or multi-syllable classic middle names, such as James, Thomas, or Alexander, flow wonderfully with Andre. The versatility of the name allows it to pair easily with almost any style.
